note: The round-3 nudge: a whole row or column of room required, and a whole row or column moved.

edits.from:
if (rows > -upper) top += Math.min(1 - upper, rows)
		else if (columns > -start) left += Math.min(1 - start, columns)
edits.to:
if (rows >= 1 - upper) top += 1 - upper
		else if (columns >= 1 - start) left += 1 - start
